Maya (Fleet): Heads-up — Vendor just pushed lead times for the next H100 tranche from 4w -> 7w. Also they flagged a partial-DOA batch that will go back via RMA and they'll ship replacements in two waves.
Sam (Procurement): ugh. Do we have committed allocation to cover the 3-week gap? cc @Hiro for RMA details. :grimacing:
Hiro (Logistics): We have 12 unallocated H100s in staging EU pool, but 22 on hold pending serial reconciliation. RMA batch is 15 units, vendor offered crossdock replacement for 10 and refund/credit for the rest.
Maya (Fleet): If lead time is 7w we need to decide: expand burst capacity elsewhere or accept credit+top-up later. What's the expedited cost to move replacements via air? @vendor-liaison-bot can you paste numbers?
vendor-liaison-bot: Vendor update: standard replacement ETA 7w. Air-expedite option = additional $6k/unit, available for up to 8 units. Customs docs lead time unchanged. Can provide AWB & proforma on request. (ref: PO# RF-998122)
Sam (Procurement): 8 units expedited at $6k = $48k. Compare vs market spot buy for 8 H100s — likely > $90k. Suggest expedite 8, accept credit for remaining 7.
Hiro (Logistics): Serial list for the RMA batch (for customs and inbound reconciliation):
```
H100-AB12-0001
H100-AB12-0002
H100-AB12-0003
H100-AB12-0004
H100-AB12-0005
H100-AB12-0006
H100-AB12-0007
H100-AB12-0008
H100-AB12-0009
H100-AB12-0010
H100-AB12-0011
H100-AB12-0012
H100-AB12-0013
H100-AB12-0014
H100-AB12-0015
```
Hiro (Logistics): Also attaching depot pickup window: Fri 09:00-17:00, carrier will supply AWB once vendor confirms expedite list.
Lee (SRE): Quick capacity note — losing 15 units across EU pool impacts our reserve by ~30% for training lanes and 15% for production inference capacity. If we only expedite 8, we still short ~7 units for some schedulers. We can shift two prod clusters to Dedicated pool temporarily but that'll increase unit cost ~+25% for that timeframe.
Maya (Fleet): Tradeoffs: expedite 8 -> get most critical training back, accept credit for 7 -> schedule procurement for later top-up. If Dedicated burst covers remaining 2 shortfall, looks OK.
Sam (Procurement): I'll negotiate a cheaper expedited slab: ask vendor if they can do $4k/unit for 8 units if we convert remaining 7 into a conditional reserve credit (applies toward future purchase within 6 months). Also request vendor to confirm HS code/commodity declaration for air shipment to avoid customs hold.
vendor-liaison-bot: Vendor response: can do $5k/unit if Redwood accepts a 6-month credit for the 7 remaining units (credit = 65% of unit price). HS code remains 8542.31. Export docs will include serial manifest. Can deliver AWB for expedited units within 48h of PO amendment.
Sam (Procurement): Counterproposal sent: $4.2k/unit expedite OR $5k + 30% service credit off next order. Waiting vendor reply. PO amendment drafted: `PO RF-998122-A1` — please review before I sign.
Maya (Fleet): Approve expedite if vendor accepts $4.2k. Hiro — if they airship 8, can you confirm customs clearance ETA and depot pickup timeline so we can update schedulers?
Hiro (Logistics): Yes — if AWB provided within 48h, customs release typically 24-48h EU inland. Depot pickup window would shift to Mon-Wed next week. I'll prebook carrier and send pickup SLA.
Lee (SRE): Also pls tag infra-team on the canary rollout. I’ll set low-priority batch limits and increase KV-cache TTL to reduce token cost while we’re capacity-tight. Command to throttle training jobs:
```
# temporary scheduler stop
rk cluster update --pool eu-training --max-inflight 40
```
Maya (Fleet): Sounds good. Sam — please capture the negotiated terms in the PO and loop legal for the credit clause. If vendor balks, fallback plan is to do spot buy for 4-5 units and dedicate-burst the rest.
Sam (Procurement): Will do. Looping legal now. Sending vendor the final $4.2k expedite ask and credit clause. ETA vendor reply ~end of day.
Maya (Fleet): Thanks all. Let's reconvene when vendor confirms. :thumbsup:
Lee (SRE): 👍 monitoring exports and will update cluster policies once Hiro confirms pickup.
Hiro (Logistics): AWB/tracking numbers to follow once vendor confirms expedited unit list. I'll post a short manifest in this thread.
vendor-liaison-bot: Vendor acknowledged counterproposal. Vendor SLA: 24-48h response. Reference ticket TKT-55801 for all docs.
